name: Anise Azeat
source:
Anise is a member of the Rune Angel Troupe and pilots the Emblem Frame Relic Raider.

Anise embodies the prime traits of the tomboy. Armed with a hasty nature, flippant attitude, excellent piloting skills, quick reflexes, surprising wit, and the physique to outperform others, Anise fits the role of "treasure hunter" she so adamantly claims. Out of combat however, Anise's unfamiliarity with the strict guidelines of the military clash with her free-spirited nature.

Anise's love for activity meshes well with her hastiness and she is generally impatient and prefers to be doing something that tests her skills. As such, Anise is frequently found exercising or in the Recreation Room playing its myriad of games that sated her thirst for challenges. Naturally, Anise relished competition and never turns down a challenge from anyone who would pit their wits and skills against her. Anise respects strength and willpower and admires Ranpha and Forte for their capabilities outside of piloting.

[Edited from [url=http://galaxyangel.wikia.com/wiki/Anise_Azeat]Galaxy Angel Wiki[/url]]
